_about: MURAVES reconstruction parameters used ONLY by the data chain (muraves/tracks_reconstruction): electronics, raw-file format, pedestals, slow control. They are merged on top of configuration/shared/reco_parameters.json and may not redefine its sections. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the code.

electronics._note: Readout electronics: number of boards and channels per board.

raw_files._note: Raw run files: number of events per run for each data type (also part of the raw file names, e.g. slaveData_evts40000_run2500_sr1.gz) and number of events per subrun file.

read_event._note: Column layout of the raw ADC text files.

pedestals._note: Calibration files: 1phe value used for a channel whose 1phe is 0 in the benchmark file (the channel is flagged).

slow_control._note: Column layout of the SLOWCONTROL files.
